name: Team Group Inc.
summary: Based in Taiwan, Team Group Inc. is a manufacturer and distributor of a broad array of electronic components. Its extensive product lineup features a variety of gaming-oriented items, including specialized memory, bundled packages, solid-state drives, and peripherals, as well as gaming USB flash drives and microSD cards. The company also provides diverse memory modules for various applications, such as high-performance overclocking, desktop, laptop, server-grade, and MAC systems. Furthermore, Team Group offers multiple solid-state drive formats, including 2.5-inch, portable, and M.2 SSDs, alongside different memory card types like MicroSD, SD, and CF. Their offerings extend to general USB flash drives and a wide selection of mobile accessories, encompassing products compatible with Apple devices, OTG adapters, charging cables, power chargers, and hubs. Additionally, the firm supplies industrial-grade DRAM modules, SSDs, and memory cards. Beyond manufacturing, Team Group Inc. actively engages in the trade of computer hardware, peripheral devices, and various electronic goods and raw materials. Founded in 1997, the company's main office is located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
